[P2] Complete the required design comparison

These handshake instructions add a feature, so CONTRIBUTING rule 3, “Write a design note before the code,” applies. The description explains the problem and cause but omits the required options analysis that includes simplifying existing logic. The fixed-versus-dynamic string decision does not address that comparison, leaving reviewers unable to assess the approach against the required alternatives. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6: document the alternatives, chosen design and rationale, and obtain maintainer agreement before continuing implementation.
